products.name: D-Cut Single Color Bags
products.description: One colour screen print on 80 GSM non woven fabric, with the handle punched into the body. The most economical printed bag we make, and where most shops start.
products.priceNotes: 9x11 is printed on one side; both sides add ₹30/kg. Full background or multi-colour printing adds ₹20/kg.

products.name: D-Cut Double Color Bags
products.description: Two colour screen print — usually the shop name in one colour and the address strip in another. Same 80 GSM D-cut body as the single colour bag.
products.priceNotes: 9x11 is printed on one side; both sides add ₹30/kg. Full background or multi-colour printing adds ₹20/kg.

products.name: D-Cut BOPP Single Color Bags
products.description: BOPP laminated D-cut with a single colour print. The lamination gives a glossy, wipe-clean surface and keeps the print sharp in the rain.

products.name: Handle Single Color Bags
products.description: Sewn loop handle stitched to the body, single colour print. The handle takes more weight than a punched D-cut, so this is the pick for heavier garments.
products.priceNotes: Full background or multi-colour printing adds ₹20/kg.

products.name: Handle Double Color Bags
products.description: Loop handle bag with a two colour print, shop name and contact strip in separate colours. Handle colour can be matched to your brand.
products.priceNotes: Full background or multi-colour printing adds ₹20/kg.

products.name: Stitching Single Color Bags
products.description: Stitched body with a side patty for depth, single colour print. Folded sarees and dress materials sit flat inside instead of creasing.

products.name: Stitching Double Color Bags
products.description: Stitched side-patty bag with a two colour print. The patty is normally run in a contrast colour to frame the front panel.

products.name: Digital Multi Color Bags
products.description: Full colour digital print, so photographs, gradients and fine Telugu type all reproduce cleanly. Send artwork in any format and we proof it with you before printing.

products.name: Digital Model Bags
products.description: Digital printed bag in our standard model shapes, full colour on both panels. A quicker route than custom artwork when you want a ready design.

products.name: Digital Handle Bag
products.description: Full colour digital print with a sewn loop handle. Dark full-surface designs hold flat on this fabric with no show-through.

products.name: BOPP Laminated Digital Bags
products.description: BOPP film laminated over a full colour digital print. The film protects the ink and wipes clean, which is why these get reused for months.

products.name: BOPP Laminated Digital Handle Bag
products.description: BOPP laminated digital print with a sewn loop handle — the most premium bag we make. Wedding season and jewellery showroom orders mostly go out in this.

products.name: HM Plastic D-Cut Covers
products.description: HM plastic carry cover with a punched D-cut handle, printed to your design.

products.name: LD Plastic D-Cut Covers
products.description: LD plastic carry cover — softer and clearer than HM — with a punched D-cut handle.

products.name: U-Cut Covers
products.description: U-cut plastic cover, gusseted so it opens wide and stands on the counter. Sized for hotel, bakery and kirana counters.

products.name: Non Woven U-CUT Bags
products.description: Non woven U-cut bag in the gusseted vest shape. Opens wide, stands on the counter and is the cheapest per piece of anything we make.

products.name: Bio Degradable U-CUT Covers
products.description: Bio-degradable U-cut cover, a compostable replacement for the plastic version in the same sizes.

products.name: Misprint Bags
products.description: Overruns and misprints from earlier jobs, sold by weight in assorted sizes and prints. The cheapest way to stock up when the print on the bag does not matter.

products.name: Misprint Covers
products.description: Overrun and misprinted plastic covers, sold by weight in assorted sizes and prints.

products.name: Plain D-Cut Bags
products.description: Plain 80 GSM D-cut bag with no printing, stocked in white and a range of fabric colours for immediate dispatch.

products.name: Plain Handle Bags
products.description: Plain loop handle bag with no printing. Handle colour can be matched to your brand.

products.name: Plain Stitching Bags
products.description: Plain stitched bag with a side patty, no printing.

products.name: Plain HM D-Cut Covers
products.description: Plain HM plastic cover with a punched D-cut handle, no printing.

products.name: Plain LD D-Cut Covers
products.description: Plain LD plastic cover with a punched D-cut handle, no printing.

products.name: Plain U-Cut Covers
products.description: Plain U-cut plastic cover, no printing.

products.name: Plain Non Woven U-CUT Bags
products.description: Plain non woven U-cut bag, no printing. Gusseted vest shape, stocked for immediate dispatch.
